# Noarka UI

> An open-source React component library built on Base UI primitives and styled with Tailwind CSS v4.

Noarka UI provides accessible, composable primitives (Button, Dialog, Select, Tabs, etc.) for building product interfaces. Styling flows through CSS variables (design tokens) defined in tokens.css. Components use the `render` prop for polymorphism (no `asChild`).

Noarka UI was originally created as a private project sorely to build Noarka applications that use the exact same design system. After careful considerations, it was published as an open source design system for everyone to use.

## Documentation
- Home: https://ui.noarka.com
- Introduction: https://ui.noarka.com/introduction
- Components: https://ui.noarka.com/components
- Theming: https://ui.noarka.com/theming
- Changelog: https://ui.noarka.com/changelog

## Installation
npm install @noarka/ui @base-ui/react @solar-icons/react class-variance-authority clsx tailwind-merge
